status: fixture recipes and run plan; not an executable runner or completed runs
repeatSeedRule: Repeat 1 uses listed seed; repeat 2 uses listed seed + 10000. Paired arms reuse the identical repeat tape, including legal act receipts and information-delivery order.

holdout.worldVariant: unfamiliar offset rooms, stairs and waterside plan
holdout.use: sealed until selected candidate; no tuning

reserve.worldVariant: unfamiliar rotated multi-floor rooms and divided garden plan
reserve.use: replace consumed holdout after repair; no tuning before confirmation

fixtureContract.actors: fake/scripted test worlds only; all movement and activity through legal engine acts; no teleports or alternate motion path
fixtureContract.geometry: Freeze generated world, public projection/assets and legal act tape hashes before any camera outcome is inspected. Failed fixture feasibility validation is unknown and requires a newly versioned comparison, never post-hoc exclusions.
fixtureContract.variation: Set seed controls legal act timing/turn choices and fixture variant; it is not runtime Math.random. Preserve refused acts and timing drift.
fixtureContract.visibility: Frame intervals are half-open [start,end), in depicted-world seconds, mapped to original-video presentation timestamps; all initial fixture intervals are feasible.
fixtureContract.holdouts: Freeze recipes, seeds and hashes without viewing candidate outcomes; keep holdout/reserve runs separate from tuning. A holdout inspected for tuning is consumed; use untouched reserve for final confirmation.

render.physicalMobile: Record and hold actual CSS/physical pixels, DPR and refresh within each paired orientation cell; never label emulation as physical.
common: same built served apps/web page except declared variant
same viewport, DPR, renderer backend, graphics/shadows/quality and refresh policy
same initial lens, zoom/preference, hour/lighting and reduced-motion setting
same browser/version/launch flags and recording/profiling settings
no shot pin or authored track in automatic-camera quality runs
render.coldWarm: Cold: fresh test context and empty camera caches, record startup separately. Warm: identical prelude and five-minute foreground warmup, retained warmed caches; reset world tape identically.

arms.selectedCandidate: named candidate commit/configuration/effort; optional methods default off unless adopted
arms.disabled: same rendered scene and legal act tape; automatic camera computation disabled with fixed manual view, only for attribution controls, never a visual-quality competitor

matrices.owner: CAM-05 establishes; visible tasks reuse affected cases
matrices.rule: Each Cartesian cell is separate; desktop uses rotated fixed viewport, physical mobile uses actual orientation. Unavailable cells are unknown; schedule additional device cells explicitly before dispatch.
Repeat the corresponding 180-second profile five times on one continuous tape; preserve coverage history across cycles.

Selected candidate is economical. This initial six-cell matrix qualifies only portrait, economical effort and the declared physical device/browser; any landscape/other effort/cold sustained claim needs separately scheduled cells. Do not claim 20 minutes per mode from a mixed run.
Reuse CAM-05 controls only with explicit source/input/assets/render/protocol applicability; invalid controls require a separately bounded re-recording task.
Run selected frozen cells within amended dispatch bounds; unrun cells remain unknown. After holdout tuning, repeat confirmation on reserve, never the consumed holdout.

mixedSession.rule: Loop each 180-second profile within its segment, truncating the final cycle; preserve camera history between cycles and switch modes with real UI input at segment boundaries.

mobileSession.rule: Loop/truncate the frozen profile tapes within each segment; real UI mode changes. Each 20-minute cell contains 14 minutes Follow and 6 minutes Broadcast; it proves neither 20 minutes per mode nor landscape coverage. Report costs and temperature by segment as well as whole run.
